title.narrative: Bridging the research/policy nexus for social transformations in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: This work plan will leverage on the "Laboratory of Ideas" function of the Organization, to address emerging societal challenges related to inequities, production and access to scientific research and knowledge products for sustainable development. The Comprehensive Strategy of the MOST (2022-2029) will guide this effort, so to secure a meaningful contribution in the region, while also addressing challenges and opportunities brought about by COVID-19, but also disruptive technologies as AI, as well as the effects of climate change. The MOST Research and Knowledge Brokerage Pillars will be privileged modalities to support the implementation of this work plan, using dedicated tools and approaches to reduce the gap between research and policy for positive social transformations in Eastern Africa, while advancing the right to science and academic freedom.
